plain: To say strongly that something is wrong; to blame.

webster.text: To pronounce to be utterly wrong; to utter a sentence of disapprobation against; to censure; to blame.

example.quote: There can be no objection, therefore, on this account, to the federal judicature which will not lie against the local judicatures in general, and which will not serve to condemn every constitution that attempts to set bounds to legislative discretion.
